A [[human]] '''individual''' worked as a [[technician]] for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] in the [[ISB Central Office]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="WEK" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Make It Stop]]" dates the fourth and final three episodes of ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' [[Andor Season 2|Season 2]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> she<ref name="JKE AD" /> helped assist [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]] at the office on behalf of a [[Raid on the Axis safehouse|raid]] being conducted on the planet at the [[Tomkip Towers]].<ref name="WEK" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The primo tech was portrayed by [[Zora Bishop]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[Who Else Knows?]]" and "[[Jedha, Kyber, Erso]]," the eleventh and twelfth episodes of the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]],<ref name="WEK" /><ref name="JKE">{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}}</ref> both of which aired on [[May 14]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
